{{Quote|P'lya Hera - Known Rebel informant. Frequents the cantinas in hopes of recruiting the common folk to the Alliance. Must be destroyed. Fairly harmless.|[[Victor Visalis]]'s hit list|<ref name="SWG:HL" />}}
'''P'lya Hera'''<ref name="SWG:HL" /> was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in the city of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BP" /> In addition, Hera was an informant and a [[Recruitment Agent|recruitment agent]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWG:HL" /> P'lya Hera was murdered sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="BP" /> by the pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer of Defense]] of Bestine [[Victor Visalis]].<ref name="SWG:HL" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
P'lya Hera was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
